objective:
Carry a sister goal's best changes onto this network's best file, for one entry on Paradigm's Prediction Market board.

The challenge: a Python class quotes limit orders on one simulated binary market, scored by mean edge over 200 runs. Simulator: https://github.com/danrobinson/prediction-market-challenge

Its best entry, 110.21 against first place's 110.69, is the start file, a JSON whose "code" is the strategy: https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/149883fee797ad95a91e535b7a74453587a3eb19ca87ab95f7d8585db160a8f4
It reads the rival's spread at the first step as self.s, 1 to 4 ticks. Every change acts only when self.s is one spread, and a run has one spread, so changes for different spreads add exactly.

The changes were built on an older file, not the start file: https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/db22aff7167a4798251ed3d20432509f30e511e4958799aba5b17b41bb39b4b6 (the start file is that one plus eight fixes, written out differently). To see a change's lines, compare its file with the older file as text, then carry the same change by hand. Each file below is the same kind of JSON, at https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/ plus its hash. Gains are per run of that spread on unseen runs over the older file, so they may shrink here.

Three use one signal: the rival's best bid falls exactly one tick, or its best ask rises exactly one tick. The price crossed that quote 98.4% of the time.
- cancel: for one callback, cancel all our orders on that side and place none. Spreads 2 and 3 +1.11 each; 1 and 4 never measured. 2d4b30bbc6bffbc500b37ce5e8a1ac821d6513c52a6a2377b4be3c11d97717fb
- cross: halve the belief's weight outside the crossed tick. Spread 1 +0.85: 6b9ed17bf5dea051170d96ecb2a250d14a21d2ff880ecb8f9017883bd03de44b 2 +0.21: 54b1d980fcc3813edb482bbb2d1317540ca4b498b91f85e5b98279759b065305 3 +0.41: 459d3ec15ee1323593c23f1933500cb42ac662c51e5e2aa89f9b1befee3640d1
- cut: multiply the belief's weight on the stale side by 0.016. All spreads +0.88 a run, on a still older file: 02547689db99b3c23e7fca6854fd610cf835480ae70fb7250c52cd3159b33be7

The others:
- postjump, spread 1, +0.50: 6a27972e9638651d891da543295d7374bb0e9ba1cdf1175e380bc264a2cb522f
- premium, spread 4, +0.34: delete b *= 1.4 and the if above it. f12abab20b33528b93dfdad56de2d7bb6a85beedbc0104cc33657e0b152ffc76
- deadband, spread 1 +1.41, 3 +0.52, 4 +1.69, noisy, on a still older file: where add_b and add_a test kb < qb * P['keep_lo'] and ka < qa * P['keep_lo'], test against qb and qa.

Nothing is tuned: use each change's own constants. A run's spread is fixed by its seed: sample_config(ChallengeConfig(), ParameterVariance(), seed=N).competitor.spread_ticks, in orderbook_pm_challenge/runner.py. Do not make the strategy recognise particular seeds. The operator enters files by hand: look for no key.
